Type: tufted leather swivel office chair
Use: working at a desk, reading; home office, study
Style: traditional, classic, rustic
Materials: distressed top-grain leather, dark stained wood star base, black metal column, casters
Colors: dark warm brown, espresso wood, black
Shape: tall wingback-style shell with diamond-tufted back, flared track arms, deep cushioned seat, five-star wooden base on casters, substantial and enveloping
Feel: warm, stately, cozy, lived-in
Goes with: dark wood desks, brass accents, bookshelves, deep green or navy walls; traditional library or rustic study rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Leather Swivel Office Chair on Wheels, 26.4"W, Brown
materials: Top-Grain Leather Upholstery; Wood And Metal Swivel Base; Metal Wheels
product.description: A tall curved back and top-grain leather upholstery give this swivel chair a strong presence in a home office. The back and armrests feature classic mid-century tufting. Firm cushioning and elastic webbing make it durable and comfortable. 26.4"W x 23.2"D x 41"H Top-grain leather upholstery; wood and metal swivel base; metal wheels. 360 degree swivel. Sturdy for up to 250 lb capacity. Top-grain leather shows unique markings. Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
